# Paths where build-scripts/reaper_hiddencheck.py downgrades the two
# content-dependent classes (bad-utf8, confusable) from fatal to warning.
# bidi-control, zero-width and control-byte stay FATAL under every plain entry;
# only a "!"-prefixed entry silences those too - last resort, third-party only.
#
# Entries: "patches/NNNN-name.patch" = that patch file; a path ending in "/" is
# an in-tree prefix; any other path is one exact file. Path entries survive a
# series renumber; patch-name entries do not (same trap as pii-allowlist.txt).
#
# Vendored third-party packages carried whole by the series. Their upstream
# sources have Latin-1 bytes in comments and changelogs (net-snmp, openssh) and
# names in other scripts in credits (tor, openvpn). Not our code, not hidden.
release/src/router/openssh-sftp/
release/src/router/net-snmp-5.9.4/
release/src/router/tor/
release/src/router/openvpn/
#
# Generated autotools files inside those packages carry literal control bytes
# by construction: autoconf's configure embeds BEL (0x07) as a sed delimiter,
# libtool's ltmain.sh embeds ESC (0x1B) for terminal colours. Generated, never
# hand-edited, and regenerated on any package bump - hard-allowed as files.
!release/src/router/openssh-sftp/configure
!release/src/router/net-snmp-5.9.4/configure
!release/src/router/net-snmp-5.9.4/ltmain.sh
#
# Stock ASUS pages copied whole into the Reaper tree in the 2026-07 UI rework:
# they carry Russian comment text from ASUS, identical to the stock firmware.
# Confusable letters there are prose inside comments, not identifiers.
release/src/router/www/R_Advanced_WAN_Content.asp
release/src/router/www/sysdep/RT-BE96U/www/Main_Analysis_Content.asp
